moments.title: Sienna Spiro reigns on Official Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' holds the UK Official Singles Chart number one spot for a third consecutive week, as announced on September 25th.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Three weeks at #1 for Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation'! What a run for the chart queen. #UKChart

angles.name: Female Artists Dominate
angles.copy: It's a strong week for female artists on the Official Singles Chart, with Sienna Spiro, Ella Langley, Stella Lefty, ADÉLA, and Dua Lipa all in the top 5!

moments.title: Avril Lavigne turns 42
moments.blurb: Pop-punk icon Avril Lavigne, known for hits like 'Complicated' and 'Sk8er Boi', celebrates her 42nd birthday today.

angles.name: Pop-Punk Princess
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to the one and only Avril Lavigne! Still rocking our worlds with those pop-punk anthems. What's your favourite Avril track?

angles.name: Still Complicated
angles.copy: From 'Complicated' to 'Girlfriend', Avril Lavigne turns 42 today! The pop-punk princess continues to inspire.

moments.title: 3 Doors Down frontman Brad Arnold is 48
moments.blurb: Brad Arnold, lead singer of the multi-platinum rock band 3 Doors Down, celebrates his 48th birthday today.

angles.name: Kryptonite Singer
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to Brad Arnold of 3 Doors Down! Still thinking about 'Kryptonite' all these years later. What's your favourite 3 Doors Down song?

moments.title: Third Eye Blind's Stephan Jenkins turns 60
moments.blurb: Stephan Jenkins, frontman and songwriter for the iconic alternative rock band Third Eye Blind, celebrates his 60th birthday today.

angles.name: Semi-Charmed Life
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 60th Birthday to Stephan Jenkins of Third Eye Blind! Still can't get 'Semi-Charmed Life' out of our heads.

moments.title: Welsh Labour calls for new devolution phase
moments.blurb: The Welsh Labour leader today called for a new phase of devolution in Wales, sparking debate at the party conference.

angles.name: Devolution Debate
angles.copy: Big news from the Welsh Labour conference today as the leader calls for a new phase of devolution. What does this mean for Wales?

angles.name: Power to the People
angles.copy: Is it time for more power to be moved to Welsh communities? The debate on devolution continues today with Welsh Labour's latest proposals.

moments.title: Queen's Roger Taylor plays Swansea
moments.blurb: Queen drummer Roger Taylor brings his 'Violence Insane in a Beautiful World' show to Swansea Arena on Tuesday.

angles.name: Rock Legend in Swansea
angles.copy: Queen legend Roger Taylor takes the stage at Swansea Arena this Tuesday! Don't miss 'Violence Insane in a Beautiful World'.

moments.title: Michael Ball live in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Musical theatre star Michael Ball performs at the New Theatre, Cardiff, on Tuesday, September 29th.

angles.name: West End Star in Wales
angles.copy: Cardiff! Michael Ball is bringing his incredible voice to the New Theatre this Tuesday. Get ready for a night of classics.

moments.title: The Amazons play Exeter Phoenix
moments.blurb: Indie rock band The Amazons are set to play a headline show at Exeter Phoenix on Tuesday, September 29th.

angles.name: Indie Rock in Exeter
angles.copy: The Amazons are hitting Exeter Phoenix this Tuesday! Expect an energetic night of indie rock. Who's going?

moments.title: Sting celebrates 75th birthday
moments.blurb: Gordon Sumner, better known as Sting, the legendary frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, turns 75 on October 2nd.

angles.name: Music Icon at 75
angles.copy: Next Friday, October 2nd, the incomparable Sting turns 75! From The Police to his incredible solo career, a true music icon. What's your top Sting track?

angles.name: Every Breath He Takes
angles.copy: Ahead of his 75th birthday on October 2nd, we're celebrating Sting's incredible career. Which era of his music do you love most: The Police or his solo work?

moments.title: Cardiff Music City Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The Cardiff Music City Festival returns from October 2nd to 17th, featuring a diverse lineup of gigs and events across the city.

angles.name: Cardiff's Music Celebration
angles.copy: Get ready, Cardiff! The Music City Festival launches this Friday, October 2nd, with two weeks of incredible live music. Check out the lineup!

angles.name: Local Music Spotlight
angles.copy: From Tom Robinson to Fairport Convention, the Cardiff Music City Festival brings a fantastic array of artists to the Welsh capital starting October 2nd.

moments.title: Gwen Stefani turns 57
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and fashion designer Gwen Stefani, known for her work with No Doubt and successful solo career, celebrates her 57th birthday on October 3rd.

angles.name: Hollaback Girl at 57
angles.copy: Next Saturday, October 3rd, the incredible Gwen Stefani turns 57! From No Doubt to 'Hollaback Girl', what's your favourite Gwen era?

angles.name: No Doubt About It
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Gwen Stefani's 57th birthday this Saturday! We're spinning all the No Doubt and solo hits.

moments.title: Brecon Beacons Food Festival returns
moments.blurb: The annual Brecon Beacons Food Festival takes place on Saturday, October 3rd, showcasing local produce and culinary talent in mid-Wales.

angles.name: Taste of Wales
angles.copy: This Saturday, October 3rd, the Brecon Beacons Food Festival is back! Get ready to indulge in the best of Welsh produce.

moments.title: Cardiff Half Marathon this Sunday
moments.blurb: Thousands of runners will take to the streets of Cardiff for the annual Cardiff Half Marathon on Sunday, October 4th.

angles.name: Runners Take Over Cardiff
angles.copy: Good luck to everyone running the Cardiff Half Marathon this Sunday, October 4th! The city will be buzzing.

angles.name: Cheer on the Runners
angles.copy: If you're in Cardiff this Sunday, make sure to cheer on the participants of the Cardiff Half Marathon! An incredible atmosphere guaranteed.

moments.title: Little Mix star Leigh-Anne Pinnock turns 34
moments.blurb: Leigh-Anne Pinnock, member of the hugely successful British girl group Little Mix, celebrates her 34th birthday on October 4th.

angles.name: Girl Group Icon
angles.copy: Next Sunday, October 4th, we're celebrating Leigh-Anne Pinnock's 34th birthday! What's your favourite Little Mix hit?

moments.title: Pet Shop Boys' Chris Lowe is 67
moments.blurb: Chris Lowe, one half of the iconic British synth-pop duo Pet Shop Boys, celebrates his 67th birthday on October 4th.

angles.name: Synth-Pop Legend
angles.copy: Next Sunday, October 4th, Chris Lowe of the Pet Shop Boys turns 67! Honouring the synth-pop legend. What's your favourite Pet Shop Boys track?

moments.title: BFI London Film Festival begins
moments.blurb: The 70th BFI London Film Festival kicks off on October 7th, showcasing a wide range of international and British cinema until October 18th.

angles.name: Red Carpet Ready
angles.copy: Get ready for glamour! The BFI London Film Festival starts October 7th. Which films are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Celebrating Cinema
angles.copy: The BFI London Film Festival's 70th edition begins on October 7th. A fantastic celebration of cinema coming to the capital.

moments.title: Duran Duran announce UK arena tour for October
moments.blurb: Duran Duran have announced their first full UK arena tour in three years for October 2026, including a special Halloween show in London.

angles.name: Duran Duran Are Back
angles.copy: Wild Boys rejoice! Duran Duran are touring the UK in October, including a huge Halloween show at London's O2! Tickets are on sale now.

angles.name: Halloween Special
angles.copy: Get your fancy dress ready! Duran Duran are promising a 'Danse Macabre Halloween Party' at The O2, London on October 31st as part of their UK tour.

moments.title: Big Premier League clashes coming in October
moments.blurb: The Premier League returns in early October with highly anticipated fixtures, including Manchester United vs Tottenham Hotspur and Liverpool vs Manchester City.

angles.name: Football Fever Builds
angles.copy: The Premier League is back with a bang in early October! Get ready for Man Utd vs Spurs on Oct 9th and Liverpool vs Man City on Oct 10th. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Crucial October Games
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! October brings some huge Premier League fixtures. Will the title race start to take shape?

moments.title: Devon council reorganisation plans under review
moments.blurb: A major overhaul of Devon's local councils, which would have seen a reduction from 11 to four authorities, is currently under review by the government.

angles.name: Devon's Political Shake-Up
angles.copy: The proposed shake-up of Devon's local councils is under government review. Big changes could be on the horizon for how the county is run.

moments.title: Investigation into Exmouth water pollution continues
moments.blurb: Public health chiefs are still investigating the blue water pollution in Exmouth, with a no-swim warning remaining in place for the beach and Littleham Brook.

angles.name: Exmouth Water Warning
angles.copy: The blue water pollution probe continues in Exmouth, with a no-swim warning still in effect. Stay safe if you're near the beach or Littleham Brook.

moments.title: Tulleys Shocktober Fest is underway
moments.blurb: Europe's largest scream park, Tulleys Shocktober Fest in West Sussex, is open until October 31st, offering haunted attractions and Halloween thrills.

angles.name: Get Your Scare On
angles.copy: Feeling brave? Tulleys Shocktober Fest is already bringing the scares in West Sussex, running right through to Halloween!

angles.name: Halloween Starts Early
angles.copy: Europe's biggest scream park, Tulleys Shocktober Fest, is open for business! Who's heading there for some early Halloween thrills?
